# land

Lands a verified, reviewed branch on its base. Takes the repo lock, syncs the base, runs the project gate, merges as the project settings allow, records the merge with a read-back, waits a bounded time for the deploy, closes linked issues, and writes a report with a named verdict. Takes the branch to land (default the current one). Use when asked to "land this branch" or "merge it", or when ship routes a verified, reviewed branch here; not for opening or describing a pull request.

| | |
|---|---|
| Who starts it | You or the agent. You can ask for it by name (`/shipyard-delivery:land` in Claude Code); the agent also starts it when the request matches the description. |
| Arguments | `[branch]` |
| Project settings | `.claude/shipyard/land.md`, `.claude/shipyard/plans/<branch>.md` |
| Settings fields | [overlay-example.md](../../plugins/shipyard-delivery/skills/land/references/overlay-example.md) |
| Hands off to | `gate failed`, or `not merged` on a conflict or a moving base, goes back to the implement stage with the report's reason; `not merged` because the user declined goes to the pull request's human reviewers; after `landed`, the demo stage when the settings name one, else done; `deploy did not run` is an andon (H5) with the manual deploy command. |
